verdict.rationale: Cursor documents a GitHub app with all-repositories or selected-repositories scoping, a GitLab integration (including self-hosted) and GitHub Enterprise Server support. Bugbot runs automatically on every PR update and leaves inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes. Community users running it in their orgs confirm it posts review comments on PRs, though one found those comments verbose. missing for 10: any evidence on review latency (the 'within minutes' part of the story)
